purpose: Discriminate the three named explanations for the Stage A momentum residual. No new solve: every number below comes from the SAME three solutions already on disk.

a_surface_quadrature.test: wedge areas and volume against their closed forms; the END faces matter and had never been tested, because on a cyclic case the two ends cancel and so would any error in them
a_surface_quadrature.verdict: REFUTED - exact to 9e-16 at every level

b_functionObject_vs_assembly.test: wall viscous force from the wallShearStress FO, differenced against nu*snGrad(U) built from the solver's own cell values and cell centres
b_functionObject_vs_assembly.verdict: REFUTED - 7.3e-07 falling to 3.0e-09, three decades below the residual and converging fast. This was the production-relevant hypothesis: had it held, every published WSS number would inherit it.

c_incomplete_development.test: inlet-to-outlet change in the radial profile
c_incomplete_development.verdict: NOT the residual's rate - the profile converges at ~2, the residual at 0.36-0.69

what_it_actually_is.claim: a FIRST-ORDER defect in the discrete solution at the inlet, which the identity detects and the velocity profile does not

pressure_odd_even_oscillation.note: the discrete p carries a period-2 oscillation in x, measured both on a single radial line and on the station mean

interior_control_volume.definition: same balance over the downstream half; the upstream face is an interior x-plane using the solver's own central interpolation and its own phi, so the inlet patch is never touched

LIMIT_OF_THIS_RESULT: The two REFUTATIONS are firm: they rest on differences of 1e-16 and 1e-9 against quantities with exact answers. The positive claim is weaker. Three levels give two apparent orders, and for the interior control volume they are 0.93 and 2.07 - not constant, so the asymptotic rate is not established. What IS established is that the interior volume closes 16.3x better than the full-domain balance at the finest level (ratio_at_finest below) while excluding only the inlet patch.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_AUDIT: The ~1e-3 is NOT an instrument artefact, so the production momentum residuals are not explained away by it. The checker was reporting a real defect. Note what the same runs do: velocity converges at 2.04 and 3.02 against the exact solution while this is happening, so a profile-based verification passes the case cleanly. That is the paper's central claim, on the configuration production actually uses.
MY_OWN_ERROR_DURING_THIS_WORK: The first development metric reported an 85% inlet-to-outlet profile change, which would have 'confirmed' hypothesis (c) immediately after the other two were refuted. Cell-centre x carries 1e-16 jitter, so lexsorting on the raw value interleaved the stations: it was comparing r=0.16 against r=0.94. The recorded momentum flux (4.7e-07, three decades below the residual) contradicted it, which is what prompted the check.
CORRECTION_8X: The prose above originally said '8x better at the finest level' while this record's own ratio_at_finest field said 16.3 - an internal contradiction. The 8.0 is 5.2529e-4/6.5641e-5, the interior balance's own coarsest-to-finest improvement, a DIFFERENT comparison from the one the sentence describes. Caught by the manuscript read-through's adversarial reviewers checking the paper against this record; the paper had inherited the 8x. Corrected in place per the repo's convention; the wrong sentence is preserved in git history.
